english_source_note: The Cantor Set and Its Properties
statement_en: Let $\{r_n\}$ be a sequence taking values only in $0,-2,2$. If $\sum_{n\geq 1}\frac{r_n}{3^n}=0$, then necessarily $$r_n \equiv 0.$$
callout_body: $\{r_n\}$是一个只能取$0,-2,2$的序列，如果$\sum_{n\geq 1}\frac{r_n}{3^n}=0$那么一定有$$r_n \equiv 0$$
